instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an indoor home setting with neutral beige walls. On the left, the person with curly dark hair and glasses (R1) stands in profile wearing a striped shirt, looking forward with a soft expression. On the right, the person in the mint waffle-knit sweater (R2) stands facing them. R2 extends their right arm, showcasing a detailed forearm tattoo, to feed a single dark cherry to R1. The two share a close, playful moment. Soft, natural indoor lighting fills the space, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the warm, neutral color palette.
